summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments on a batch upload pipeline PR, then after merging, update project documentation (DEFERRED.md, FEATURES.md, README.md) and create a new filesystem specification document on a dedicated docs branch.
summary.outcome: All 4 review threads resolved and committed; docs branch created with PR #419 containing updated DEFERRED.md (thoroughly audited), FEATURES.md, README.md, and a new FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md; several stale/incorrect deferred items removed after multiple correction rounds.

repo: Error tracking is implemented via Grafana Faro (apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts), not Sentry — Sentry was never adopted.
FUSE unit tests are intentionally absent; Desktop E2E suite covers FUSE integration since unit testing would require mocking too much of the host OS.
Vault v1 legacy columns were fully removed when staging was reset; the baseline migration (1700000000000-FullSchema.ts) was written post-reset and contains no v1 fields.
Session replay is explicitly out of scope as an anti-feature for a zero-knowledge privacy product.

The 'lazy file reading within concurrency pool' issue (useDropUpload.ts:140) was independently flagged by both CodeRabbit and GitHub Copilot — it maps to a known deferred item requiring SDK contract changes to accept File objects instead of Uint8Array.
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS is an operator-level env var, not a user-facing setting — user-configurable bin retention is still a deferred item.
Desktop app uses the Rust FUSE crate directly, not the JS SDK — deferred items about 'desktop adoption of JS SDK exports' were not applicable.
Linux FUSE mount was implemented (crates/fuse/src/platform/linux.rs); CTR streaming was implemented in crates/fuse/src/operations.rs.
pin:secondaryFailed event was implemented in Phase 37, making the 'batch upload secondary pin warning events' deferred item obsolete.
Per-file IPNS conflict detection has been live since Phase 12.6 via per-file IPNS metadata.

code.finding: getWorker() and postMessage() can throw, leaking entries in the pending map — fixed with try/catch that cleans up the pending entry on failure.
uploadFiles() doc comment overstated memory bounding — clarified to reflect actual batching behavior.
Reads all files into memory before SDK call (batch reads). Architectural issue requiring SDK API change to accept File/callback instead of Uint8Array; intentionally deferred.

workflow: When asked to audit and prune a list, do every item systematically in one pass — not just the ones explicitly called out by the user.
GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation can batch multiple thread resolutions in a single call.
Use --field (not -f) for integer parameters like in_reply_to when posting PR review replies via gh api REST.
Integration tests hitting a live backend will fail in CI without a running backend — distinguish pre-existing failures from regression before aborting.
Planning docs (DEFERRED.md, FEATURES.md) accumulate drift quickly; they need active verification against the codebase rather than trusting their own content.

friction: DEFERRED.md required three correction rounds because the initial audit was shallow (only spot-checked rather than exhaustive), frustrating the user who had to keep pointing out specific stale items.
The Edit tool appeared to reformat table whitespace/column widths, requiring re-reads and workarounds to get exact match strings for subsequent edits.
Push required a retry (first push attempt failed, likely remote tracking issue on new branch).
Commit failed with parentheses in the message on one attempt, requiring reformulation with dashes.
open_items: Lazy file reading in useDropUpload.ts — requires SDK API change to accept File objects or a read callback instead of Uint8Array (tracked as deferred, flagged by both CodeRabbit and Copilot).
User-configurable recycle bin retention period (RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS is operator-only).
Rust SDK batch upload support (feature matrix shows JS SDK only for batch uploads).
Observability items still in deferred: structured log shipping pipeline, distributed tracing across API/IPFS/FUSE layers.
Upload pipeline deferred items: resumable uploads, per-file progress granularity improvements.
Code quality deferred items carried forward from phases 28-37.
Cross-platform filesystem gaps documented in FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md (5 documented gaps including Windows case-insensitivity handling).
